value_flows.flow: harvest: Claims rewards from staking contract via claimRewards, then deposits claimed RON to vault via _depositRONTo.
value_flows.order: 1. claimRewards (external), 2. get contract balance, 3. _depositRONTo (external).

value_flows.flow: harvestAndDelegateRewards: Claims rewards and delegates them to a validator via delegateRewards.
value_flows.order: 1. delegateRewards (external).

value_flows.flow: delegateAmount: Delegates RON from contract to validators via delegate{value}.
value_flows.order: 1. loop: delegate (external).

value_flows.flow: redelegateAmount: Redelegates RON between validators via redelegate.
value_flows.order: 1. loop: redelegate (external).

value_flows.flow: undelegateAmount: Undelegates RON from validators via bulkUndelegate, then deposits undelegated RON to vault.
value_flows.order: 1. bulkUndelegate (external), 2. _depositRONTo (external).

value_flows.flow: deposit: Forwards RON deposit to vault via vault.deposit.
value_flows.order: 1. IVault(payable(_vault)).deposit (external).

value_flows.flow: delegate: Receives RON, increases staking amount for user.
value_flows.order: 1. _sync, 2. stakingAmounts update.

value_flows.flow: undelegate: Decreases staking amount, sends RON back to user.
value_flows.order: 1. _sync, 2. stakingAmounts update, 3. external call to msg.sender.

value_flows.flow: redelegate: Moves RON from one validator to another.
value_flows.order: 1. _sync src, 2. _sync dst, 3. stakingAmounts updates.

value_flows.flow: bulkUndelegate: Loops undelegate for multiple validators.
value_flows.order: 1. loop: undelegate (external).

value_flows.flow: claimRewards: Claims pending rewards and sends RON to user.
value_flows.order: 1. _claimRewards, 2. external call to msg.sender.

value_flows.flow: delegateRewards: Claims rewards and delegates them to a validator.
value_flows.order: 1. _claimRewards, 2. _sync dst, 3. stakingAmounts update.

value_flows.flow: deposit: Mints WRON to msg.sender for RON sent.
value_flows.order: 1. _mint.

value_flows.flow: withdraw: Burns WRON and sends RON back to msg.sender.
value_flows.order: 1. _burn, 2. external call to msg.sender.
